segments.subtask: The robot arm moves towards the green mat where a white food item and a blue tool are located.
The robot arm grasps the white food item with the right gripper.
The robot arm lifts the food item and moves it towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the food item into the right basket.
The robot arm moves back to the green mat to pick up the blue tool.
The robot arm grasps the blue tool with the right gripper.
The robot arm lifts the blue tool and moves it towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the blue tool into the right basket.
The robot arm moves to the left side of the green mat where a black container and a white item are located.
The robot arm grasps the white item with the left gripper.
The robot arm lifts the white item and moves it towards the left basket.
The robot arm places the white item into the left basket.
The robot arm moves back to the green mat to pick up the black container.
The robot arm grasps the black container with the left gripper.
The robot arm lifts the black container and moves it towards the left basket.
The robot arm places the black container into the left basket.
